verdict.rationale: Numeral's pricing page claims it can "Validate customer VAT IDs live", and the product covers global jurisdictions, so the core VAT-ID validation part of the story has a first-party claim. Nothing in the pack describes how validation works or how B2B cross-border reverse charge is handled. missing for 10: documentation of validation against official registries (e.g. which registries are queried and how), any evidence of reverse-charge logic applied in calculations, API-level docs for VAT ID validation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, B2B cross-border sales are handled correctly — VAT and tax IDs validated against official registries in real time, reverse charge applied when it should be

citations.quote: Register, file, and remit across US and global jurisdictions, on time, every time.
